Speech.greeting: Eddies up front, choom. Browse all you like.
Speech.select: Good eye. That one's clean, no serial numbers.
Speech.purchase: Pleasure doing business. Don't say where you got it.
Speech.sell: I'll take it off your hands. Don't expect retail.
Speech.noFunds: No eddies, no deal. Come back when you're flush.

UI.PresentDisabled: This shop is closed to players. Enable it in shop settings so they can trade.
UI.ClosedToPlayers: Closed to players. Turn it on in shop settings.
UI.PreviewBanner: Preview of unsaved changes. Trades are off.
UI.PreviewNoTrade: Trades are off in preview. Save and open the shop to trade.
UI.EmptyShop: The shelves are empty. The GM can stock them in shop settings.
UI.EmptyCategory: Nothing in this section right now.
UI.NothingToSell: This character has nothing the shop will buy.
UI.PickBuyer: Select or assign a character to trade.
UI.PickItem: Pick an item to see its details.
UI.PickToSell: Pick one of your items to see the offer.
UI.SellHint: Pick an item on the left, set how many, then sell.
UI.NoShopNearby: No shop in range. Move your token next to a shopkeeper.
UI.TooFar: Too far away. Move your token next to the shopkeeper.
UI.SellWithUpgrades: Its installed upgrades are sold with it.
UI.SellUnloads: It will be unloaded first; the rounds go back to your ammo.

Error.NoGM: A GM must be connected to trade.
Error.Timeout: The GM didn't answer in time. Try again.
Error.ItemGone: An item in your cart is no longer for sale. It was removed; check your cart and try again.
Error.NotEnoughStock: Only {stock} of {name} left. Lower the quantity and try again.
Error.NotBuying: This shop isn't buying right now.
Error.CannotSell: The shop won't take that item. Installed cyberware, core items and unpriced items can't be sold.
Error.ShopBroke: The shop only has {funds} in cash. Sell less or try another shop.
Error.BadActor: That character or shop no longer exists.
Error.NotOwner: You can only trade for characters you own.
Error.NoWealth: {name} has no eurobuck wallet, so it can't trade.
Error.SelfTrade: A shop can't trade with itself.
Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can change shop settings.
Error.WrongSystem: Neon Market is built for Cyberpunk RED - CORE. This world runs {system}, so prices and wallets won't work.

Keybinding.InteractHint: Opens the shop of the closest shopkeeper token within interaction range of your token.

SellRate.Name: Default sell rate
SellRate.Hint: Share of an item's market price a shop pays when characters sell to it. Shops and single items can override this.

PlayersCanSell.Name: Players can sell to shops
PlayersCanSell.Hint: Turn off to make every shop buy-only.

RequireApproval.Name: GM approves every trade
RequireApproval.Hint: Players' purchases and sales wait for the GM to accept them.

InteractRange.Name: Interaction range
InteractRange.Hint: How close, in scene units (meters by default in CPR), a token must be to a shopkeeper to open the shop. 0 means any distance.

Receipt.Name: Chat receipts
Receipt.Hint: Post a receipt to chat after each trade.
Receipt.Private: Only the GM and the character's owners

ShowTiers.Name: Show price categories
ShowTiers.Hint: Label items Cheap, Everyday, Costly and so on, using the core rulebook's price categories.

Duck.Name: Scene music while shopping
Duck.Hint: Playlist volume while a shop is open, as a share of normal. The shop's own music plays over it.

Config.Title: Shop settings
Config.EnabledHint: Players can only open a shop that is open for business. You can always open it as GM.
Config.Subtitle: Subtitle
Config.ArtHint: A tall portrait with a transparent background looks best on stage.
Config.ThemeHint: Picking a theme also sets its layout and colors. You can change them afterwards.
Config.LabelsHint: Leave blank to use the default wording.
Config.CatalogHint: Drag items or item folders from the sidebar or a compendium onto a category. Leave price blank to use the market price for one purchase (ammo is priced per 10 rounds, as in the rulebook). Stock -1 means unlimited.
Config.NothingToImport: This actor has no priced items to copy.
Config.Imported: Copied {n} items into a new category.
Config.EmptyCatalog: Drop items or item folders here to create your first category.
Config.Skipped: Skipped {n} items that can't be sold, such as skills and roles.
Config.AudioHint: Music loops while the shop is open and fades out on close. Scene music is turned down while shopping.
Config.SellRateHint: Leave blank to use the world default ({pct}%).
Config.BuybackHint: Sold items appear in a Buyback tab at the price the shop paid.
Config.ClearBuybackConfirm: Remove every item from this shop's buyback list?
Config.FundsHint: With limited cash, the shop stops buying from characters when it runs dry, and sales to characters refill it. Using this actor's own eurobucks records every trade in its CPR ledger.
Config.UnsavedConfirm: Close without saving? Your changes will be lost.
Config.VendorHint: This is a Cyberpunk RED container. Its vendor settings still apply here: item types it isn't buying are hidden from the Sell tab, and its buy percentages are used when this shop has no rate of its own.
Config.SellRateHintVendor: Leave blank to use this container's vendor percentages, or {pct}% for types it doesn't set.
